create_plugin.title: Plugin editor
create_plugin.subtitle: Create your own collection type (figures, cards, comics...) without writing code. The plugin is generated in the plugins/ folder and becomes usable immediately, just like the built-in modules. Plugins created here are manual-entry only (no external API).
create_plugin.creator_hint: The main field attached to each item (like “Artist” for music).
create_plugin.secondary_desc: Adds a second editable visual (like the disc for music).
create_plugin.default_cover_desc: Shown on items added without a cover. Leave empty to keep the DVinyl logo.
create_plugin.default_cover_too_big: This image is too heavy (max 512 KB once optimised). Try a smaller one.
create_plugin.basics_desc: Enable the ready-made fields you want on this item type.
create_plugin.formats_desc: Optional: the variants of your items (e.g. New / Used, Standard / Collector). Each format gets its colored badge and filter.
create_plugin.default_format_desc: Value already picked when adding an item. Leave on "No format" so the choice is always explicit.
create_plugin.fields_desc: Add your own fields: text, number, dropdown, checkbox...
create_plugin.extra_fields_hint: Fields you add here exist only in this collection and apply to every item of this type.
create_plugin.delete_confirm: Delete this plugin? The %COUNT% existing item(s) will stay in the database but will no longer be visible.
create_plugin.err_bad_id: The plugin identifier is invalid (lowercase, digits and dashes, 2 to 30 characters).
create_plugin.err_reserved_id: This name is reserved by the application, pick another one.
create_plugin.err_id_taken: A plugin or folder already uses this name.
create_plugin.err_bad_icon: The icon is invalid (expected format: fa-xxx).
create_plugin.err_bad_default_cover: The default image is invalid (PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 512 KB, or a http(s) link).
create_plugin.err_creator_required: The creator field label is required.
create_plugin.err_bad_field_name: A custom field has an invalid name.
create_plugin.err_reserved_field: A custom field uses a reserved name (title, year, barcode... are already handled).
create_plugin.err_duplicate_field: Two custom fields share the same name.
create_plugin.err_select_needs_options: A dropdown needs at least one option.
create_plugin.err_too_many_options: Too many options on a single field (maximum 100).
create_plugin.err_too_many: Maximum number of custom plugins reached (30).
create_plugin.customize_hint: Icon and badge colors, applied to this collection only.
create_plugin.card_fields_hint: Shown under the cover in every grid, in the order the plugin declares them. Up to {{count}}.
